cvStructure.issue: The CV has no dedicated Skills or Technical Skills section, even though tools like AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Prometheus and Grafana are mentioned only inside bullet points.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a 'Technical Skills' section listing these tools explicitly (e.g., AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana) so ATS systems can match them more reliably.

sectionOrganization.issue: In the Projects section, the graduation project has no date while the self-hosted Git server project shows '(2025)', making the chronological order unclear.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: Add a month/year or semester date to the graduation project entry so both projects follow the same date format and order.

keywordUsage.issue: Several key tool names are misspelled ('Kubernets', 'Git Hub Actions', 'Terrafrom'), which may prevent ATS systems from matching them to standard keywords.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Correct the spellings to 'Kubernetes', 'GitHub Actions', and 'Terraform' throughout the Experience section.

keywordUsage.issue: The graduation project description does not mention any specific technology, language, or tool used.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add the actual technologies used on the servers part of the graduation project (e.g., the OS, cloud platform, or scripting language) to strengthen keyword relevance for Cloud/DevOps roles.

readability.issue: The summary claims 'over 3 years of professional experience', but the Experience section only shows about 8 months in the current role plus a 3-month internship, totaling less than one year.
readability.suggestion: Update the summary to accurately reflect the actual duration of professional experience shown in the Experience section.

readability.issue: The Cloud Operations Intern bullets ('Monitoring', 'Server stuff and deployments', 'Helping with tickets') are short fragments without action verbs or measurable outcomes.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite these as full bullet points starting with action verbs and, where possible, add a specific result, similar to the log rotation bullet already in that role.

readability.issue: The graduation project description is vague ('I worked on the servers part with my team and it was successful') and does not explain what was built or achieved.
readability.suggestion: Describe the specific task performed on the servers (e.g., deployment, configuration, scaling) and mention any measurable outcome or technology used.

contentFormatting.issue: Dates are formatted inconsistently: most entries use 'Mon YYYY - Mon YYYY' while the self-hosted Git server project only shows '(2025)'.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Use the same 'Mon YYYY' or 'Mon YYYY - Mon YYYY' format for the self-hosted project date to match the rest of the CV.

contentFormatting.issue: The Cloud Operations Intern entry mixes short phrase fragments with a full sentence bullet, breaking the consistent bullet style used elsewhere in the CV.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Reformat all bullets under this role as complete sentences, matching the style used in the Junior DevOps Engineer section.
